items.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01
items.q: And we had D.D. on trumpet.

ctx.x: Yeah, to St. Louis from New York. But anyway, I finished telling you. They called this band the Southern Syncopators. And they had Alan Prairie, the big 330 pound man. He was, all he did was directing. He looked good in front of the band. And we had D.D. on trumpet. D.D. Pierce?

items.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20
items.q: Paul Barnes and I, we got a band, Sunset Syncopator

ctx.x: Cassie. The Young Tuxedo. The Young Tuxedo. Oh, I see. What are some of the other dance bands you played with?
Well, Paul and I, Paul Barnes and I, we got a band, Sunset Syncopator, and we've done a lot of work here, too. There's a lot of different, you know, outfits.
You've made some records with different people, too. Emile Barnes. Yeah, I mean, when we were born, yeah.
Way before Depression when you were with Celestan. Oh yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. Was it before you were with Paul Barnes?

Yeah, with Celestan, yeah, I imagine so, yeah, yeah. And I joined Paul after. I saw him the other day. Paul? Yeah, they won a, what was that Billy? They played? We met Paul. I was with you. Oh, that's right you were, that's right you were, yeah, yeah.
It was a Sunday after Depression.

items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: Well I left here with Paul Barnes. I think he's still playing. He's in Chicago now. He left here. Me and his brother. We formed a band and we traveled.

ctx.x: I'm telling you about myself. Well I left here with Paul Barnes. I think he's still playing. He's in Chicago now. He left here. Me and his brother. We formed a band and we traveled. Yeah, he was all signed. I got a card. Yeah, he got a card for him. And then we organized a seven piece band. Well then we traveled all around up to Lake Charles. There where we, Nellie Lutcher joined my band then. She was the pianist in our band. That's before I had married Willie, before I met Willie. And I traveled all over part of…
Mm-hmm. Did you ever run across Lawrence Dewey out there in that part of the country around Lafayette or New Iberia?
